title: Simultaneous sign-ups get lost
problem: Reported: two people signed up at the same moment, only one is in the list. Reproduced with test/concurrency.test.js (20 simultaneous sign-ups keep only 1). Cause: signUp and cancel do store.load → change → store.save; concurrent requests load the same old state and the last save wins (map debt 'concurrent-writes').
facts: src/events.js signUp and cancel both call store.load() then store.save(db)
src/store.js save() rewrites the whole file
assumptions: The site runs as a single Node process (true for `npm start`)
later: Several server processes sharing one file would still conflict; needs a real database or file lock
